notes: Cropped fragment of a PH VAT official receipt. 'KUMHO INC' appears after 'RECEIVED from' and is therefore the PAYER/CUSTOMER, not the vendor; extracting it as vendor_name is a fabrication. Printed labels 'Total Sales (VAT Inclusive)' and 'Less: VAT' establish this as VAT-registered. All hand-written values are unreadable. No document border is visible, so perspective-correction quad detection must decline to warp this image. CORRECTION: an earlier note here asserted the vendor header was out of frame, based on a default-PSM read. The multi-variant read recovers 'VAT Reg. TIN: 143-009-119-00000 + Leonido G. Gath...-Prop.', so a vendor header does exist but is only partly legible. Since the image cannot be inspected directly, vendor_name and vendor_tax_id are moved to unknown rather than asserted either way.
